sentences.zh: 它们更常见的名字是“簇生木腐菌”。

sentences.en: I deep dived on these mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我深入研究了这些蘑菇。

sentences.en: I'm guessing they grow on wood.
It is a type of mushroom and they grow on rotten trees, stumps or trunks.
sentences.zh: 这是一种蘑菇，它们生长在腐烂的树木、树桩或树干上。

sentences.en: The taste is very bitter if you eat them raw, but they are not bitter if you cook them.
sentences.zh: 生吃的话味道非常苦，但如果煮熟了就不苦了。

sentences.en: They are poisonous either way, cooked or raw.
sentences.zh: 但无论生吃还是煮熟，它们都有毒。

sentences.en: Why would anyone cook them if they're poisonous?
sentences.zh: 既然有毒，为什么还会有人煮它们呢？

sentences.en: How do we even know what they taste like?
sentences.zh: 我们又是怎么知道它们是什么味道的？

sentences.en: Because a common poisoning technique would be to cook these mushrooms with non-poisonous mushrooms
sentences.zh: 因为一种常见的投毒手法就是把这些蘑菇和无毒的蘑菇一起煮，

sentences.en: and then feed them to your enemy.
And it's sort of like an undetectable way to poison someone to death.
sentences.zh: 这是一种让人难以察觉的毒杀手段。

sentences.en: So clearly this has been done.
sentences.zh: 所以显然有人这么干过。

sentences.en: Did you see the movie Phantom Thread starring Daniel Day-Lewis?
sentences.zh: 你看过丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯主演的电影《魅影缝匠》吗？

sentences.en: Because this is a plot point in the movie.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是电影里的一个情节。

sentences.en: And if you tell me to watch it, I'm going to watch the first 15 minutes of it.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你让我去看，我大概只会看前15分钟。

sentences.en: Well, you're going to miss the mushrooms because they happen later.
sentences.zh: 那你就会错过蘑菇的情节了，因为那是后面才发生的。

sentences.en: Here's what happens to you if you eat these mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 如果你吃了这些蘑菇，会发生什么。

sentences.en: It can take up to 5 to 10 hours before you get symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 症状可能需要5到10小时才会显现。

sentences.en: Now, most of the time, the symptoms will resolve themselves after a few days.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，症状会在几天后自行消失。

sentences.en: But they can cause death if you eat too many.
sentences.zh: 不过如果吃得太多，可能会导致死亡。

sentences.en: So guys, spoiler alert, Phantom Thread is an amazing movie.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，剧透预警，《魅影缝匠》是一部很棒的电影。

sentences.en: I'm not going to watch it.
As if anyone's ever going to take my movie recommendations again.
sentences.zh: 好像还会有人再听我的电影推荐似的。

sentences.en: I did watch this one all the way through twice.
sentences.zh: 这部电影我完整地看了两遍。

sentences.en: Stop listening here for 10 seconds if you don't want me to spoil the movie for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想被剧透，现在起跳过10秒。

sentences.en: So, but someone gets poisoned with mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 总之，有人被蘑菇毒害了。

sentences.en: Do they have a little towel by their coffee pot?
sentences.zh: 他们的咖啡壶旁边有小毛巾吗？

sentences.en: No, but they have a wonderful English kitchen that looks like it's really fun to cook in.
sentences.zh: 没有，但他们有一个很棒的英式厨房，看起来在里面做饭一定很有趣。

sentences.en: So there is some great shots of a great kitchen.
sentences.zh: 所以里面有一些很棒的厨房镜头。

sentences.en: I'll be sure and check out the shots of the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我一定会去看看那些厨房的镜头。
放过疾速追杀吧，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Maybe once you get your Carvel cake, you'll forgive me.
sentences.zh: 也许等你吃到Carvel蛋糕，你就会原谅我了。

sentences.en: Once I join everyone who's ever celebrated their birthday at work or school.
sentences.zh: 等我加入那些在工作或学校过生日的人的行列之后吧。

sentences.en: Anyway, that is the download on the mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 总之，这就是关于蘑菇的情况。

sentences.en: Well, you know the scene where Dwight tackles Michael to the ground?
sentences.zh: 你知道德怀特把迈克尔扑倒在地的那一幕吗？

sentences.en: There was much more of this in the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 删减片段里还有很多这样的内容。

sentences.en: There is a great talking head where Michael's like,
sentences.zh: 有一个很棒的访谈镜头，迈克尔说，

sentences.en: You know, when Dwight tackled me to the ground and was fishing the mushrooms out of my mouth with his finger.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当德怀特把我扑倒在地，用手指从我嘴里抠蘑菇的时候。

sentences.en: He's like, when Dwight had his finger in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 他说，当德怀特的手指伸进我嘴里时。

sentences.en: He said, I laid back and I looked at the sky and the birds were chirping and there were clouds and it was so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他说，我躺在那儿看着天空，鸟儿在鸣叫，云朵飘过，一切都那么美好。

sentences.en: And then I vomited because it was really gross.
sentences.zh: 然后我就吐了，因为那真的很恶心。

sentences.en: It's really funny that he had this sort of beautiful moment while Dwight was trying to fish the mushrooms out of his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他能在德怀特试图从他嘴里抠蘑菇的时候产生这种美好的瞬间，真是太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I have to ask, is that talking head, is he wearing his torn up clothes or is he wearing Dwight's sweatshirt?
sentences.zh: 我得问问，那个访谈镜头里，他穿的是那身破烂衣服，还是德怀特的运动衫？

sentences.en: No, it would have been like a wrap up talking head about his day and he was in his office with the Battlestar Galactica sweatshirt.
sentences.zh: 不，那应该是一个关于他这一天的总结访谈，他当时在办公室里，穿着那件《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》的运动衫。

sentences.en: Well, I love this idea that his clothes are tattered.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他衣服破破烂烂的这个点子。
他可能已经在衣服上吐过了。

sentences.en: And Dwight has to give him this rescue sweatshirt that was in his trunk.
sentences.zh: 然后德怀特不得不把后备箱里的那件备用运动衫给他穿。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I want you to know at 18 minutes, 31 seconds, when Dwight and Michael come back and they walk in the party and Michael immediately starts hitting those high notes,
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我想让你知道，在18分31秒，当德怀特和迈克尔回来走进派对，迈克尔立刻开始飙高音的时候，

sentences.en: The camera pans the conference room and Toby, Pam, Angela and Oscar are all standing together and they are smiling so big.
sentences.zh: 镜头扫过会议室，托比、帕姆、安吉拉和奥斯卡都站在一起，笑得特别开心。

sentences.en: And I thought, oh, my God, Toby and Angela are happy to see Michael and Oscar.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪，托比和安吉拉见到迈克尔和奥斯卡居然这么高兴。

sentences.en: Like, I expect Pam to smile at him, you know, but the fact that Toby and Angela were relieved to see Michael.
sentences.zh: 比如，我本以为帕姆会对他微笑，你知道的，但托比和安吉拉看到迈克尔回来时如释重负，这很有意思。

sentences.en: Well, they did not enjoy Jim being in charge.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们确实不喜欢吉姆当负责人。

sentences.en: We had a fan catch in this scene, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，这一幕我们收到了粉丝提问。

sentences.en: From Andrea T., who would like to know who made the peach cobbler for Creed because it's in a Pyrex dish.
sentences.zh: 来自安德烈·T，她想知道是谁给克里德做了桃子脆皮馅饼，因为那是装在派热克斯玻璃盘里的。

sentences.en: Did Angela go home and make this cobbler because she is so dedicated to throwing the perfect birthday party?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉是不是回家做了这个馅饼，因为她一心想举办一场完美的生日派对？

sentences.en: So, listen, I thought about this, too, and I think Angela did.
sentences.zh: 听着，我也想过这个问题，我觉得安吉拉确实做了。

sentences.en: I think when Creed said to Jim, tell Angela it's for Creed, she'll know what to do, Angela went home and made his favorite peach cobbler pie.
sentences.zh: 我想当克里德对吉姆说“告诉安吉拉这是给克里德的，她会知道该怎么做”时，安吉拉就回家做了他最爱的桃子脆皮馅饼。

sentences.en: Well, at 18 minutes, 56 seconds, you guys, there is a great shot of the Fudgy the Whale cake.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，在18分56秒的时候，有一个“鲸鱼软糖”蛋糕的绝佳镜头。

sentences.en: And, Jenna, as we're wrapping up this scene, Jim and Michael have this fantastic moment where Jim is like, I tried to do all of their parties on one day.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，在这一幕快结束时，吉姆和迈克尔有一个很棒的瞬间，吉姆说他尝试把所有人的生日放在同一天过。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, oh, yeah, I did that.
sentences.zh: 然后迈克尔说，哦，是啊，我也干过那事。

sentences.en: It's this glimpse into Michael where he's kind of talking to a peer, right?
sentences.zh: 这让我们瞥见了迈克尔作为普通人的一面，他当时是在和同僚对话，对吧？

sentences.en: He's always manager-ing us or always wanting to be in that position of status to us.
sentences.zh: 他平时总是在管理我们，或者总是想在我们面前保持那种地位。

sentences.en: But here he is talking manager-on-manager to Jim.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，他是以经理对经理的身份在和吉姆交谈。

sentences.en: And it's such a human moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常人性化的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, Jim's like, I'm not going to be here in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，吉姆说“我十年后不会待在这里了”。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, yeah, that's what I said.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔回答说“是啊，我当时也是这么说的”。

sentences.en: So as we close out this episode, Jenna, I thought we could hear just the final end of Jim and Michael's scene together.
sentences.zh: 那么在这一集结束之际，珍娜，我想我们可以听听吉姆和迈克尔最后那段对手戏的结尾。

sentences.en: Well, I tried to put all the birthdays together at once.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我试着把所有人的生日放在一起过。
所以，真是个糟糕的主意。
十年后，你就会摸索出来的。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think I'll be here in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我十年后不会待在这里了。

sentences.en: I say stuff like that, you know, to lighten the tension when things sort of get hard.
sentences.zh: 我会说那种话，你知道的，是为了在气氛有点紧张的时候缓和一下。

sentences.en: Is Michael finally eating what was in the bag?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔终于在吃袋子里的东西了吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like he's eating nuts.
sentences.zh: 听起来他像是在吃坚果。

sentences.en: I looked at it, and it's like, I can't tell what they are.
sentences.zh: 我看了看，就是，我看不出那是什么。

sentences.en: You know what they look like?
sentences.zh: 你知道它们长什么样吗？

sentences.en: Like, if you get a Chex mix, there are these little stubby pretzel bite things.
sentences.zh: 就像如果你买了一包混合零食，里面会有那种短短的小块椒盐卷饼。

sentences.en: Or they look like slivered almonds.
sentences.zh: 或者它们看起来像杏仁片。

sentences.en: But as I watched that lovely scene that I absolutely love, I was wondering, what is he eating?
sentences.zh: 但当我看到那个我非常喜欢的可爱场景时，我在想，他到底在吃什么？

sentences.en: I'll have to go back and look.
Well, you guys, that was Survivorman.
sentences.zh: 好了，伙计们，刚才那是《求生者》。

sentences.en: I don't think I'd make it out in the woods.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没法在树林里生存下来。

sentences.en: I do think I'd make it at party planning.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得我能搞定派对策划。

sentences.en: I'd make sure everyone had their dang cake.
sentences.zh: 我会确保每个人都能吃到他们该死的蛋糕。

sentences.en: Next week, we have the deposition that has some of my favorite scenes of all time.
sentences.zh: 下周，我们将讨论那场证词陈述，里面有一些我个人最喜欢的场景。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening.
Thank you for sending in your questions and your comments.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家发来的问题和评论。

sentences.en: Everyone send Angela a cake on her birthday.
sentences.zh: 大家记得在安吉拉生日那天给她寄蛋糕。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》的“第二杯”。
